test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two trains of equal length take 10 s and 20 s, respectively, to cross a pole. If these trains are moving in the same direction, then how long will they take to cross each other?
solution:
**Given:**

Two trains of equal length take 10 s and 20 s, respectively, to cross a pole.

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Relative Speed (Same Direction) = Difference of Speeds

Time taken to cross each other = (Sum of Lengths) / (Relative Speed)

**Calculation:**

Let the length of each train be L.

Speed of first train = L / 10

Speed of second train = L / 20

Relative Speed = (L / 10) - (L / 20)

⇒ Relative Speed = (2L - L) / 20

⇒ Relative Speed = L / 20

Time taken to cross each other = (2L) / (L / 20)

⇒ Time taken = 2L × 20 / L

⇒ Time taken = 40 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
